caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a brown jug or pitcher with a handle. The jug has a cylindrical body, a slightly uneven rim, and a spout for pouring. The handle is attached to the upper right side of the jug, arching outward and connecting back near the base of the mouth. The color of the jug is a dark, earthy brown, with some variations and shading that suggest texture and form. The background is a plain, light beige color, with scattered small dark specks and a slightly darker square area around the jug that may indicate a faded or stained section of the paper. In the bottom right corner, the artist's signature, “RICHARD BARNETT,” is visible.
title: Earthenware Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
